articles.title: NASA, OPM Launch NASA Force to Recruit Top Talent for US Space Program
articles.summary: The U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM) and NASA announced NASA Force on Wednesday, a dedicated talent track within the US Tech Force initiative designed to recruit and deploy the nation’s top engineers and technologists to support America’s space program. articles.title: US-French Satellite Takes Stock of World’s River Water

articles.title: SLS upper stage helium flow problem fixed
articles.summary:
Workers have completed repairs to the helium pressurization system in the upper stage of the Space Launch System, keeping a potential April launch of the Artemis 2 mission on track.
